current_evidence: The official Validation page (cornwall.gov.uk/planning-and-building-control/planning-applications/validation/, 'Last Updated 02/09/2026') still links validation-guide-17-web.pdf as 'Validation Guide'; the replacement 'Validation Guide 2026 DRAFT' was consulted on 17 July to 7 August 2026 on Let's Talk Cornwall and is still at Step 3 'Finalising and publishing' (not adopted).

issues.detail: The guide is about to be replaced and the workbook doesn't record this. Cornwall consulted on a 'Validation Guide 2026 DRAFT' from 17 July to 7 August 2026. It is now being finalised for formal adoption, so version 17 should be flagged as due for replacement and rechecked once the new guide is adopted.
issues.evidence: letstalk.cornwall.gov.uk/validation-guide: 'Consultation process begins 17 July 2026', 'Consultation period ends 07 August 2026', 'Step 3 is now taking place' (finalise, adopt and publish); draft file 'Validation Guide 2026 DRAFT - For Consultation.pdf'

issues.detail: The List date (2024-04-01) comes from the PDF's CreationDate metadata, not from text in the document, and neither the Validation page nor the Validation updates page gives an adoption date for version 17. The date is unverified and should be labelled as metadata or replaced with a date stated in the document's 'Adoption and Review' section.
issues.evidence: reference_row 'Date basis': 'PDF metadata CreationDate'; validation page gives only the web page's 'Last Updated 02/09/2026'

issues.detail: Several app-type rows use a trigger from a different requirement. 'Structural Survey' uses the Tree Survey trigger. 'Agricultural / rural workers' dwelling appraisal' and 'Agricultural Land Classification / Soils' both use the application form/ownership certificates text. 'Statement of Community Involvement' uses the Town Centre Impact Assessment trigger, which duplicates the Retail row. 'Schedule of works (listed building)' uses the moveable-structure Method Statement. 'CIL Additional Information' and 'Environmental Statement (EIA)' both use the boilerplate list of legislation.
issues.evidence: Structural Survey: 'When required: Any proposals involving development within two metres of the canopy spread of a tree'; Agricultural rows: 'When required: All applications What is required: A full Application for Planning Permission form'; Schedule of works: 'Method Statement NR ... installing the moveable structure'

issues.detail: Many triggers are sentence fragments or come from the guide's list of reasons applications are made invalid, not from the 'When required' text. 'Drainage Strategy / SuDS' and 'Foul Sewage / Utilities Statement' both say 'Missing foul drainage assessment form where required' (a duplicate). Heritage Statement says 'Missing heritage statement ... where required'. Pre-application says 'of any pre-application advice.' Crime prevention says 'information regarding crime prevention or other considerations.' Planning Obligations says 'It is vital that proof of title is provided'. Transport says 'a full Transport Statement assessing the impact is required.' Contaminated Land uses a line about BS 10175 methodology from a separate guidance PDF. Highways starts mid-sentence. None of these tells a user when the document is needed.
issues.evidence: trigger_excerpt values in app_type_rows for the named requirements

issues.detail: The Fire Statement trigger is garbled ('where the development meets the fire risk condition, the fire safety impacts on the intended occupants'). The council's own updates page gives the actual threshold: a relevant building with 2 or more dwellings or educational accommodation that is 18m or more in height or has 7 or more storeys.
issues.evidence: Validation updates page, Fire statements: 'relevant building ... 2 or more dwellings or educational accommodation ... 18m or more or has 7 or more storeys'

issues.detail: Some triggers are incomplete or misleading. Air Quality runs two sentences together and ends 'such development is not supported'. Flood Risk Assessment gives only the 'critical drainage problems' trigger and leaves out Flood Zones 2 and 3 and sites over 1ha. Design and Access Statement gives only the WHS/Conservation Area 100sqm case and leaves out major development, 1+ dwellings in designated areas and listed building consent. Photographs is entered as a requirement although the excerpt itself says photographs are 'not required to validation'.
issues.evidence: Photographs: 'Although not required to validation existing property photographs can provide extremely useful information'; Air Quality: '...Planning for Air Quality such development is not supported.'

issues.detail: The app-type mapping is mostly guesswork. About 38 requirements are 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning', and almost every other type (Outline, Reserved matters, Listed building consent, Advertisement, s73, LDC, etc.) is set to '(none)'. The Cornwall guide is a single guide for all application types, so this mapping is wrong. Householder gets only an Ecology row, although the Tree Survey, Block Plan, Site Levels, Roof Plan and Parking/Highways triggers plainly cover householder extensions. Listed building consent shows no requirements, although a heritage statement is needed. Telecommunications supplementary information ('mast and antenna development') also applies to telecoms prior approvals.
issues.evidence: notes: 'INFERRED: application type not named in extracted text of a general local list; placed under Full planning - check source for applicability'

issues.detail: Two requirements are filed under 'Change of use - prior approval' because their text contains the words 'change of use': the Nutrient Neutrality calculator/statement and the Odour Impact Assessment. Both are local requirements for planning applications (full/outline/change-of-use applications) in the River Camel catchment or near odour-sensitive uses, not prior approval requirements. The Ecology row under Householder ('Ecology Report Trigger Table ... All householder development') appears to be a heading of the ecology trigger table, not a rule that every householder application needs an ecology report.
issues.evidence: 'Nutrient Neutrality - River Camel Phosphate Budget Calculator and Nutrient Neutrality Statement LR When required: Required for developments within the River Camel Catchment Area...'; 'Odour Impact Assessment LR When required: Change of use to odour generating activities...'

issues.detail: Several current validation changes on the council's Validation updates page are missing. (1) A detailed air quality assessment with a mitigation plan is needed where agricultural, industrial or traffic-generating development is likely to affect a habitats site (SPA/SAC/Ramsar) or an SSSI, under Natural England standing advice of 16 Oct 2025. (2) Descriptions containing 'retrospective', 'retention' or 're-submission' are not accepted. (3) A scale bar is needed for each scale ratio shown; this is only partly captured. (4) Plans copied from the council's interactive mapping are not accepted. (5) The BNG trigger still reads 'Applications submitted from 12th February 2024' and ignores the exemptions from 6 August 2026: sites of 0.2ha or less, and temporary permissions of 5 years or less. It also ignores that the self-build exemption no longer applies to new applications after 6 August.
issues.evidence: Validation updates page: 'Air pollution and development ... standing advice on 16 October 2025'; 'retrospective, retention or re-submission ... no longer accepted'; 'From 6 August 2026 ... 0.2 hectares or less'

issues.detail: Many tab_items are process text, boilerplate or fragments, not requirements. Examples: 'It gives additional powers to help protect our environment...'; 'We have sought guidance from other Authorities (including Plymouth City Council...)'; '7 working days to validate'; '21 days to submit'; 'refunded minus a 10% administration fee'; 'Less invalid applications on receipt'; the Planning Portal support email/phone and 25mb file limit; all five validation checking service lines (6 days, 2/3 days, 'Once the fee has been paid a Validation Officer will: 1.', 2 and 3 working days); 'We have further updated the Validation Guide ... 21 October'; 'View the phosphates flowchart Ordnance Survey...'; 'PUBLIC 38 Nutrient Neutrality – Small Scale Sites' (a heading); 'Guidance can be found on the Cornwall Council web page'; 'Form 2 - AA Template... S111 forms and payments should now be submitted online'. One item runs on into the 'Adoption and Review' section and is cut off mid-word.
issues.evidence: tab_items in sections 'Drawing / document standards', 'Submission rules' and 'Policy-driven requirements (all application types)'

issues.detail: The 'do not scale' wording is captured twice with different rules, and the two contradict each other. The updates page accepts 'do not scale for construction purposes', while the guide text Grokbot quotes says any 'do not scale' wording must be removed. The workbook doesn't reconcile them.
issues.evidence: 'From the 1 June we only accept 'do not scale for construction purposes'' vs 'Any do not scale wording removed including any wording which indicates the LPA is unable to scale from the plans.'

summary: Grokbot's link is still the adopted Cornwall Validation Guide (v17), linked from the council's validation page updated 02/09/2026, but a 2026 draft replacement has been consulted on and is being finalised. The PDF cannot be fetched by the tool (robots disallowed), so contents were judged only from Grokbot's own excerpts and the council's updates page. Those show many wrong or fragmentary triggers, guessed application types, missing 2025-26 updates, and lots of process text entered as requirements.
